optimizer: fresh AdamW, constant LR, weight_decay=0.0001; identical continuation budget in every arm
coarse_policy: Original Full Last for corresponding seed; same frozen intermediate and Query geometry shared by all four arms within seed. Different parent seeds are paired replications, not identical Coarse across seeds.
fine_initialization: Original Full Last for corresponding seed; no zero reset. E0 is matched Fine continuation, not reproduction of original joint R5 training.
training_inputs: Fixed original cached Depth/Mask/Rays, no additional augmentation in this limited mechanism screen. No Camera B or true/estimated labels from real data.
l2_definition: Per-image sum(fine_delta_m ** 2), domain means summed, not residual-threshold gating
l2_calibration: Once before training, 32 Native TRAIN plus 32 Scan TRAIN at seed11 parent, hash-ranked. Lambda=0.1*median(norm(weighted_base_last_layer_gradient))/median(norm(unweighted_L2_last_layer_gradient)), shared all arms/seeds, no VAL/B calibration.
old_selection: Min Native identity-equal vertex_camera_mm over evaluated epochs including epoch0
joint_selection: Min 0.5*(Native identity-equal full_mask_Z_median / epoch0 baseline)+0.5*(Scan identity/asset/camera-group equal full_mask_Z_median / epoch0 baseline), constrained each domain mean hit_rate and IoU >= own epoch0 baseline - 0.01. Include epoch0, earliest epoch tie-break.
real_metrics: Reuse fixed historical heldout sensor points, transforms and exact point-to-triangle evaluator. BEHAVE fitted reference PVE supporting. No fitting or model selection with heldout cameras.
